craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of the Lord's array, limb by limb — weapon-and-ensign song. Am-stanza (he-I-lorded-standing-am); Fear-not prohibition per UNC (mā+bhaiṣṭa). Rejected: (a) softening prohibition → killed by UNC. Read aloud: WORLD-fear-SLAY-er … FEAR-not … POINT-us, LORD.

lines: World-fear slayer — he, I, lorded, standing — am. Fear not.
So shield-clash shown — point us, Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhavabhayahantā so 'ham sānāthye 'vasthito 'smi | mā bhaiṣṭa ity āsphoṭitakheṭakadarśanato diśasi naḥ svāmin

reads_against.argmap: Why fear not? → Fear-killer established lordly; shield shown pointing.
c1_essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta of spreading goddess; vīra of unopposed-in-me; adbhuta of as-if showing; vīra of commanded seeing; adbhuta of cast cloth; vīra of best heroes; abhaya-vīra of fear-not; vīra of counted time; vīra of hurled distinction; vīra of deer-pierced cause
